LESSON: SIGN READING 6.2.2 COMPREHENSION

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade three
Subject: General
Strand: Strand 6
Topic 6.2: Sign reading 6.2.2 Comprehension
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Sign reading 6.2.2 Comprehension, part of Strand 6 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade three General.

Key inquiry question: What do you think will happen in this story? 2. What do the pictures tell us about the story?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Sign reading 6.2.2 Comprehension together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Critical thinking and problem solving: as the learner responds to comprehension questions.

● Creativity and imagination: as the learner makes predictions and applies prior knowledge to answer indirect questions.

Values:
Peace: as the learner displays tolerance with peers when working together

Link to

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Citizenship: Social cohesion as the learner discusses the title and pictures in texts with peers.

Link to other Learning Areas

Comprehension skills are applicable in all learning areas.

Suggested Learning Resources

Assistive devices fitted with appropriate technology such as Hearing aids and amplifiers, charts showing words with the target letter sounds, flash

cards showing words with target letter sound, signed audio-visual recordings, print or digital stories, pocket charts, print and digital flash cards
